flags.evidence: Checkpoint 1185ccd selected naca0012_m015_inviscid metadata SHA256 038c0dcd8f1902255e3a411d77a58a2f328e1ae7aa63f6079ecf58270d0b69b3 says completed=true, statistically_periodic. Its checkpoint-matched forces.csv SHA256 8613113c292b69c738b5b35d8a9f5df4c6ead7dd067b9a6f0df49049d76ab511 shows Cd descending from +0.510818 at step12001 to −0.054502 at step20000, including −0.026512→−0.054502 in final400; Cl −0.03513→−0.016532 over final4000. Delivered force plot visibly confirms continued drift rather than a stationary or periodic state. Immutable report.tex:21,875 and run_manifest.md:23,32–35 characterize steady cases as converged/statistically periodic. Re20 and Re200 status=failed are separately disclosed and are not charged merely for failure. No CFD rerun.

limitations: No evaluator rerun was performed; cylinder Re200 was never rerun.
Structural validation is separate from substantive numerical scoring.
Raw solver artifacts remain workspace evidence and were excluded from the curated submission tip.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
